mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (login_id, nickname, password_hash, provider, provider_id, role) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{nickname}, #{passwordHash}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, nickname, password_hash, provider, provider_id, role, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
